shorts.title: A Storm Threw a Baby MEGALODON Into His Pool

shorts.description: A storm drops a two metre megalodon pup into Doug's pool. Megalodon died out about 3.6 million years ago, its name means big tooth, and its biggest teeth reach about 18 centimetres. The full thirty days is linked below.
